component.name: SuperAwesomeMagicalEmail
component.summary: Read and write the mail on your SuperAwesomeMagicalEmail server

description.p: Your SuperAwesomeMagicalEmail server on the desktop: every mailbox it gives you (PurelyMail and any other service), together or one at a time, read and written natively.

ul.li: All your inboxes together, or any account's folders
HTML mail shown safely, with images from the web hidden until you ask
Replies, forwards, attachments, drafts and signatures
Notifications for new mail, even with the window closed
